fields.name: allow_longer_sd_id
fields.description: If true, Fluent Bit allows SD-ID values longer than 32 characters. SD-ID values that exceed 32 characters violate RFC5424 standards.

fields.name: host
fields.description: Domain or IP address of the remote Syslog server.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Desired transport type. Available options are tcp and udp.

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP or UDP port of the remote Syslog server.

fields.name: syslog_appname_key
fields.description: Optional. The key name from the original record that contains the application name that generated the message.

fields.name: syslog_appname_preset
fields.description: Optional. The preset application name. It will be overwritten if syslog_appname_key is set and a key of a record is matched.

fields.name: syslog_facility_key
fields.description: Optional. The key name from the original record that contains the Syslog facility number.

fields.name: syslog_facility_preset
fields.description: Optional. The preset facility number. It will be overwritten if syslog_facility_key is set and a key of a record is matched.

fields.name: syslog_format
fields.description: The Syslog protocol format to use. Available options are rfc3164 and rfc5424.

fields.name: syslog_hostname_key
fields.description: Optional. The key name from the original record that contains the hostname that generated the message.

fields.name: syslog_hostname_preset
fields.description: Optional. The preset hostname. It will be overwritten if syslog_hostname_key is set and a key of a record is matched.

fields.name: syslog_maxsize
fields.description: The maximum size allowed per message. The value must be an integer representing the number of bytes allowed. If no value is provided, the default size is set depending on the protocol version specified by syslog_format. The value rfc3164 sets max size to 1024 bytes, and rfc5424 sets the size to 2048 bytes.

fields.name: syslog_message_key
fields.description: Required. The key name from the original record that contains the message to deliver.

fields.name: syslog_msgid_key
fields.description: Optional. The key name from the original record that contains the Message ID associated to the message.

fields.name: syslog_msgid_preset
fields.description: Optional. The preset message ID. It will be overwritten if syslog_msgid_key is set and a key of a record is matched.

fields.name: syslog_procid_key
fields.description: Optional. The key name from the original record that contains the Process ID that generated the message.

fields.name: syslog_procid_preset
fields.description: Optional. The preset process ID. It will be overwritten if syslog_procid_key is set and a key of a record is matched.

fields.name: syslog_sd_key
fields.description: Optional. The key name from the original record that contains a map of key/value pairs to use as Structured Data (SD) content. The key name is included in the resulting SD field as shown in the examples in this doc.

fields.name: syslog_severity_key
fields.description: Optional. The key name from the original record that contains the Syslog severity number.

fields.name: syslog_severity_preset
fields.description: Optional. The preset severity number. It will be overwritten if syslog_severity_key is set and a key of a record is matched.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
